# Code Of Conduct

Be respectful, constructive, and considerate of different experiences and backgrounds.

Do not harass, discriminate against, threaten, impersonate, or publish another person's private information. Keep technical feedback specific and focused on the work.

Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content and limit participation when necessary. Report conduct concerns privately through a maintainer-provided channel; do not repeat private information in a public issue.

Maintainers must publish an appropriate private contact mechanism before presenting this project as a supported public community.
